name: Menace Drone
description: Static minor-tonic vamp with a minor v and no leading tone: the Nick Cave menace drone. Aeolian throughout, no functional dominant. The family also runs barer as i-bVII (Tupelo) or i-v (The Mercy Seat); this is Loverman's fuller three-chord form.
source: Nick Cave & the Bad Seeds, via Ultimate Guitar chord sheets (Tupelo, The Mercy Seat, Loverman)
